run_scannetppv2_conversion: run the ScanNet++ v2 to WAI format conversion script for DSLR modality scenes
get_semantic_class_mapping: get the ScanNetv2 semantic class string to string and string to id mappings from metadata files
map_scannetv2_semantic_class: map ScanNetv2 semantic class strings to a filtered unified set of class strings using a benchmark CSV
map_semantic_class_to_index: map annotation semantic class strings to integer label indices using the semantic class mappings
convert_scene: convert a single ScanNet++ scene to WAI format including images, poses, mesh, and semantic annotations
